events.title: Celebrate Diwali at the Field Museum!
events.display_title: [FREE] Celebrate Diwali at the Field Museum!
events.location_address: 1400 S Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60605
events.description: Join us for our second annual Diwali celebration as we honor the Festival of Lights and the rich cultural traditions of South Asia! Experience an afternoon of vibrant dance performances, interactive cultural activities, and opportunities to explore the connections between science, history, and tradition. From classical Indian dance and contemporary Bollywood to an engaging conversation on Ayurveda, discover how South Asian traditions celebrate light, knowledge, and renewal. Music will be provided by DJ J-Mean. Our popular henna station returns this year, free for all attendees! Guests can also connect with local community organizations and learn more about the diverse cultures, traditions, and contributions of South Asian communities throughout Chicagoland. Featured Dance Performances The following take place in Stanley Field Hall Mandala Arts | Bharatanatyam Experience the beauty and storytelling of Bharatanatyam, a classical Indian dance tradition rooted in South India. Through intricate movements, expressive gestures, and rhythmic footwork, Mandala Arts brings to life stories and traditions that have been shared across generations. U Chicago Raas | Raas-Garba Celebrate the energy and joy of Raas-Garba, traditional folk dances from Gujarat, India. U Chicago Raas brings a contemporary collegiate interpretation of these vibrant traditions, combining rhythmic movement, colorful choreography, and the spirit of community celebration. Latin School of Chicago - Latin Laddoos Performance Group The South Asian Students of the Latin School (Junior K to 8th Grade) will perform contemporary and traditional group dance. They have performed dances choreographed by Bollywood Groove and Meher Dance in 2026. Rhythm Roots | Bollywood and Indian Folk Dance Get ready for a lively celebration of Indian dance! Featuring talented young performers ages 6–14, Rhythm Roots showcases an exciting blend of Bollywood, Garba, Bhangra, and contemporary fusion. Guests will also have an opportunity to join the fun through an interactive dance experience!
